mapper.select:
select tread_code, GROUP_CONCAT(sm.MACHINE_ID ORDER BY sm.MACHINE_ID SEPARATOR ',') as machine_ids from T_TM_SPECIFY_MACHINE sm inner join T_TM_MACHINE_INFO m on sm.machine_id = m.id where sm.DEL_FLAG = '0'
and sm.JOB_TYPE = #{jobType} /*限制作业 类型*/
and m.STATUS = '0' and m.DEL_FLAG = '0' group by tread_code

select mouth_plate_code, GROUP_CONCAT(sm.MACHINE_ID ORDER BY sm.MACHINE_ID SEPARATOR ',') as machine_ids from T_TM_MOUTH_PLATE sm inner join T_TM_MACHINE_INFO m on sm.machine_id = m.id where sm.DEL_FLAG = '0' and sm.status = #{status} and m.STATUS = '0' and m.DEL_FLAG = '0' group by MOUTH_PLATE_CODE

select ID, MACHINE_CODE, MACHINE_NAME, WIDTH_MIN, WIDTH_MAX, THICK_MIN, THICK_MAX, QUATA, CLASS_SHIFT, OPEN_MACHINE_CLASS, supports_all_mouth_flag, STATUS, REMARK from T_TM_MACHINE_INFO where STATUS = '0' and DEL_FLAG = '0'

SELECT a.*, b.machine_name AS machine_name, b.quata AS quota FROM T_TM_MACHINE_MAINTENANCE a LEFT JOIN T_TM_MACHINE_INFO b ON a.machine_id = b.id WHERE a.is_delete = 0 AND a.STOP_START_TIME >= concat(#{scheduleDate}, ' 19:00:00') AND a.STOP_END_TIME < DATE_ADD(concat(#{scheduleDate}, ' 19:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
